Answer concisely with source URL.

content.text:
**2016 年。**

Express Tribune 于 2016 年 4 月 12 日（4 月 13 日见报）刊登的报道《AKU becomes country’s first hospital to introduce ‘Neuro-Robotic Exoscope’》中写道：Aga Khan University Hospital (AKUH) “has become the first medical centre to introduce the new advanced brain surgery technology, Neuro-Robotic Exoscope, in Pakistan”。

来源：https://tribune.com.pk/story/1083560/medical-development-aku-becomes-countrys-first-hospital-to-introduce-neuro-robotic-exoscope
